name: Checkbox
purpose: Lets users select one or more independent options from a set, or confirm a single binary choice.
neverUseFor: Multiple mutually exclusive choices — use RadioGroup instead
A single on/off setting applied immediately — use Switch instead
Triggering an action — use Button instead
rationale: Checkbox wraps a native <input type='checkbox'> so Space-to-toggle, focus and the checked state come from the browser. It deliberately has one fixed 16px control and no size prop — it does not follow the ADR-004 field scale, because a selection mark doesn't need density variants and a single size keeps forms visually consistent.

mayExtendLocally: Write the label and helper text per usage
Control the checked/indeterminate state from product logic
mustEscalateToDS: Adding a size prop or new control sizes
Replacing the native input with a styled div
Changing the checkmark, border or fill tokens

authored.name: required
authored.description: The checkbox must be checked before form submission.

authored.name: indeterminate
authored.description: Mixed state — neither fully checked nor unchecked (e.g. a 'select all' controlling a partial selection).
authored.aria: indeterminate is a native DOM property, not an HTML attribute — set imperatively via ref

anatomy.description: Layout wrapper for the control, label, and messages.
Wraps the native input, visual control, and text.
The native checkbox input. Visually styled via sibling selector, not hidden.
Visual box — reflects checked/indeterminate state via CSS.
Check or minus icon inside the control.
Visible label text. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).
The required indicator (*), text/danger, 2px (spacing/3xs) after the label — shown by `required`. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

Helper text below the control. Sits exactly 8px below it — see .ai/maps/patterns/form-field-spacing.md. Disabled: dims to text.disabled with the rest of the text (.ai/maps/patterns/disabled-state.md).

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown below the control.

height.note: No size prop exists — Checkbox has one fixed control size (--helix-checkbox-size, 16px). Unlike Input/Select/Textarea, it does not follow the ADR-004 field scale.

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis: hover/focus are CSS pseudo-classes in code. invalid,  disabled,  checked and indeterminate are their own false/true toggles (contracts/figma-conversion.json,  pattern checkable).

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description: Shown when checked is false or true alike in code; the mark is a minus and the box fills like checked.

figma.variantCombinations: 21 variants,  only the ones code can show (owner-approved 2026-10-20). Enabled: mark (unchecked = checked false + indeterminate false · checked = checked true + indeterminate false · indeterminate = checked false + indeterminate true) × invalid false/true × state default/hover/focus = 18. Disabled: the 3 marks with invalid false and state default = 3 — a disabled checkbox takes no hover or focus,  and disabled overrides invalid. checked + indeterminate together is not drawn: indeterminate wins in code,  it would duplicate the indeterminate variant. Disabled dims the label,  the required * and the description (text/disabled).

KeyboardToggle.reason: keyboard focus — the focus ring is drawn in Figma (owner 2026-10-21: focus states are drawn)
